items.title: Jon Weber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 2, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I said I should get you and Phil Schaap together... [INTERVIEWEE] He’s the Jeopardy champion. He would mop the floor with me. He knows everything.

ctx.x: I’ve never been. I just want to see it. I want to see the Caspian Sea. I want to hang out. I don’t know a soul there. I just want to take a look to see what I can hear, see what —
Well you seem innately curious, and I also was thinking a couple of times I said I should get you and Phil Schaap together and you can have a —
He’s the Jeopardy champion. He would mop the floor with me. He knows everything.
